officialText:
Section 110.33(A) – Revise Section 110.33(A) to read as follows:

(A)Entrance. At least 1 entrance to enclosures for electrical installations as described in 110.31 not less than 30 in. (762 mm) wide and 6 1/2 ft (2 m ) high shall be provided to give access to the working space around the electrical equipment.
